two-sample-z-statistic.def: The test statistic of a two-sample z test for proportions: $z = \frac{\hat{p}_1 - \hat{p}_2}{\sqrt{p_c(1 - p_c)\left(\frac{1}{n_1} + \frac{1}{n_2}\right)}}$, the observed difference measured in standard errors from 0. The denominator is the standard error built from the pooled proportion $p_c$.
